entities.summary: Major Harris III was an American R&B singer, associated with the Philadelphia soul sound and the Delfonics. His biggest hit as a solo artist was the 1975 single "Love Won't Let Me Wait". Major Harris was a composers & musicians from Richmond (1947-02-09, Richmond–2012-11-09). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
